name: Split
action: Compare full positive dressed source with its rescaled far-tail periodization; distinguish source zeros from Fourier zeros.

name: Falsify
action: Hunt source zeros in both central window and tail fundamental cell; independent validation follows any claimed obstruction.

name: Reverse
action: Apply the exact difference operator recovering literal Phi; use it only as a control, not a discovery.

name: Viewpoint
action: Change positive-source representation while analytically preserving the spectral zeros inside the RH strip.

name: Visual
action: Save source root positions and repeated far-tail witnesses for a strip map.

name: Action
action: Vary shift base and decay; compare actual source versus its tail limit.

name: Essentials
action: Retain all geometric shifts to a precision-dependent cutoff, all theta terms, exponential source tails, and multiplier poles.

name: Similar
action: Compare primes2,3,5,7 with composites4,6 and noninteger2.5. No automatic Euler interpretation for controls.

name: Small
action: A single geometric shift operator is the minimum intervention; alpha1 and alpha.5 are fixed distinct regimes.

name: Extreme
action: Search near the source analytic boundary and test roots translated by8 and16 shift lengths.

name: Experiment
action: Embedded60digit pilot, then28 cases under one600second cap;14workers maximum. Selected roots require100/160digit independent checks.

name: Invariant
action: Derived Fourier multiplier is nonzero with no poles in |Im w|<.5 for alpha>=.5; numerical recurrence and quasi-periodicity are cheap controls.

name: Monotone
action: Do not assume increasing alpha or shift size removes more nodes; compare entire configurations.

name: Weaker bridge
action: A validated single source zero refutes global logarithm for that representation; failed root starts cannot prove zero freedom.

name: Stronger hunch
action: Test whether source zeros recur in Floquet tails even when central scans appear empty. This is a candidate, not assumed.

name: Minimal counterexample
action: One independently validated interior source zero suffices against a proposed zero-free representation.

name: Representation
action: Use geometric shift resolvent and its bilateral exponentially weighted periodization; preserve boundary poles explicitly.

name: Technique
action: Cached deep/source-method searches and a recent resummation paper motivate checking cancellations across kernel and resummation; no physics theorem transfers.

name: Fake proof
action: A nonvanishing Fourier multiplier preserves spectral zeros but does not imply a zero-free source or an RH selector.

name: Missing lemma
action: A globally controlled zero-free positive source representation plus a valid source-to-spectrum theorem; neither follows from finite scans.

name: Dependency
action: Literal theta -> positive shift convolution -> exact geometric multiplier -> source-node witnesses; no connection to HB action is asserted.

name: Nearby false
action: Do not set new exponential tails to zero or call a positive source sufficient for RH.

name: Boundary
action: Use alpha>=.5 only; poles at Im w=+-alpha remain. Complex source strip is |Im z|<pi/4; node absence is never inferred from a finite search.

name: Salvage
action: If complex nodes persist, locate their tail structure and retain the zero-preserving representation as an exact candidate for a different analytic method.
